description: Thirty stable prompts spanning Huse's main pedagogy and visual-operator families.

cases.topic: How a file moves from a laptop to cloud storage
cases.learning_goal: Explain each transfer stage and where the file state changes.

cases.topic: How drinking water is treated
cases.learning_goal: Trace water through filtration, disinfection, and distribution.

cases.topic: How an online order is fulfilled
cases.learning_goal: Follow an order from checkout through delivery.

cases.topic: Folder and file hierarchy in a file system
cases.learning_goal: Show how directories contain subdirectories and files.

cases.topic: A simple company reporting hierarchy
cases.learning_goal: Distinguish organization levels and reporting paths.

cases.topic: Biological classification hierarchy
cases.learning_goal: Explain the nesting from kingdom to species.

cases.topic: Compare SQL and NoSQL databases
cases.learning_goal: Choose a database using structure, consistency, and scale criteria.

cases.topic: TCP versus UDP
cases.learning_goal: Compare reliability, ordering, latency, and use cases.

cases.topic: Compare solar and wind power
cases.learning_goal: Contrast generation conditions, variability, and siting.

cases.topic: How the greenhouse effect warms Earth
cases.learning_goal: Connect incoming radiation, absorption, and outgoing heat.

cases.topic: How a refrigerator moves heat
cases.learning_goal: Trace refrigerant state and heat transfer around the cycle.

cases.topic: How vaccination builds immune memory
cases.learning_goal: Explain antigen recognition, response, and memory formation.

cases.topic: Key milestones in the history of the internet
cases.learning_goal: Connect early networks, TCP/IP, the web, and broadband in time.

cases.topic: Development of cell theory
cases.learning_goal: Order the observations that produced modern cell theory.

cases.topic: Milestones in human spaceflight
cases.learning_goal: Place orbital flight, lunar landing, stations, and commercial flight in sequence.

cases.topic: Derive the quadratic formula by completing the square
cases.learning_goal: Justify each algebraic transformation from standard form to the formula.

cases.topic: Calculate compound interest with a worked example
cases.learning_goal: Substitute principal, rate, periods, and time into the compound-interest formula.

cases.topic: Use Bayes theorem for a medical test example
cases.learning_goal: Update a prior probability using sensitivity and false positives.

cases.topic: Trace binary search through a sorted array
cases.learning_goal: Show index bounds, midpoint comparison, and the narrowed interval.

cases.topic: Trace recursive factorial execution
cases.learning_goal: Follow call-stack growth, base case, and returned values.

cases.topic: How a JavaScript event loop schedules work
cases.learning_goal: Trace tasks from the call stack through queues and back to execution.

cases.topic: How cellular respiration produces ATP
cases.learning_goal: Connect glycolysis, the citric acid cycle, and oxidative phosphorylation.

cases.topic: Anatomy of a neuron and signal flow
cases.learning_goal: Relate dendrites, cell body, axon, and terminals to signal direction.

cases.topic: How DNA information becomes a protein
cases.learning_goal: Trace transcription and translation from gene to protein.

cases.topic: How a balance sheet stays balanced
cases.learning_goal: Relate assets, liabilities, and equity using the accounting equation.

cases.topic: Why bond prices move opposite to interest rates
cases.learning_goal: Explain how discount rates change the present value of fixed cash flows.

cases.topic: How a stock-market order book matches trades
cases.learning_goal: Trace bids and asks through price-time priority to an execution.

cases.topic: How a fictional Velorian loop transfers a signal
cases.learning_goal: Teach an unfamiliar named system using only the supplied component relations.

cases.topic: The fictional Amberfold phase transformation
cases.learning_goal: Show a made-up material changing through three explicitly named states.

cases.topic: Compare two fictional Orbitweave routing methods
cases.learning_goal: Compare invented methods without relying on catalog keyword matches.
